items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to eliminating additional fees for special license plates issued to veterans
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S3956

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in
relation to eliminating additional fees for special license plates
issued to veterans

 PURPOSE :

To eliminate additional application fees and annual fees for special
license plates issued to veterans of the armed forces of the United
States.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section 1. Subdivisions 1 and 1-a of section 404 of the vehicle and
traffic law, subdivision 1 as amended by section 21 of part G of
chapter 59 of the laws of 2009 and subdivision 1-a as added by chapter
415 of the laws of 2001, are amended to read as follows:

1. The commissioner may issue special number plates to applicants
therefore in the same manner as other number plates are issued
pursuant to this article. Such special number plates shall be issued
only upon payment of an annual service charge of thirty-one dollars
and twenty five cents in addition to the regular fee prescribed by
section four hundred one of this article.

 JUSTIFICATION :

At the present time there are almost thirty types of distinctive
veterans license plates. These plates had their fee schedules arranged
by motor vehicle departmental regulation or by statutory action.
Consequently, the fees vary for different veteran's organizations.

This is a unique time in our history. This is a time to honor our
veterans for their unselfish service in times of need. Never before
have we been so keenly aware of the selfless dedication of those who
defend our freedom. Elimination of additional fees for special license
plates issued to veterans would enable our veterans to proudly display
that they unselfishly served our great country.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New bill

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

To be determined

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Eliminates additional application fees and annual fees for special license plates issued to veterans of the armed forces of the United States.
